scientific_choices.choice: Paper section3.5 Algorithm2 falls back to DeepSolo(I) when confidence is low. CLIP and kernel segmentation are user-requested extensions, outside STRICT.
Replay Text+Kernel epoch61 frozen seeded crop/PARSeq results: native word F1 .621272, original bbox F1 .613320; 1109 total outputs, 1029 care outputs, 480 casefold-exact spatial matches.

Whole-image minimum over every original prediction, including 80 ignored predictions; no removal, correction, top-k, or native-confidence prefilter. Empty output or empty OCR routes to DeepSolo. GT ignore masks are evaluation-only.

Reuse fixed crop square-canvas word prompts, glyph rendering and text/background contrast. Scene-only controls compare original full-image embeddings with each same word prompt. Similarities and CDF ranks are not probabilities.

Deterministic SHA256(seed:sample_id) split 80 calibration/45 validation before inference. Fit label-free mid-CDF references only on calibration words. Search calibration score breakpoints for >=99% detected-word accuracy AND zero unsafe accepted images, maximizing accepted image coverage then words. Choose family by calibration only, lexicographic final tie. Keep validation fixed; no retuning on it.

Also export explicitly post-hoc all125 threshold diagnostics, not selected deployment thresholds. Correct means maximum one-to-one bboxIoU>=.5 and casefold exact; wholly ignored predictions are excluded only from accuracy evaluation using the saved original protocol.

Report requested correct/detected accuracy=TP/(TP+FP) alongside TN0 accuracy including missed words=TP/(TP+FP+FN); FN here refers only to GT of accepted images. Separately count image-level all-emitted-text correctness and complete scene correctness.

Sequential frozen CLIP only, FP32/batch16/four CPU threads; stored original pixels without EXIF transpose; explicit CPU or cuda:0 with deterministic TF32-disabled backends; no automatic fallback. Record memory and errors.

The repeatedly used TRAIN holdout and few safe images cannot establish 99% population safety. Independent official TEST routing, DeepSolo end-to-end gain and target3070 memory qualification remain unresolved.

Fix native_word_advantage family after inspecting B32 validation in the exploratory battery. Per-model thresholds still use calibration only. Efficiently infer this exact prompt/crop contrast without computing unused glyph/scene signals; qualify against byte-checked full-battery outputs. This is post-hoc family selection, not an independent validation of the chosen method.
